ESC.title: Desk-level watch
ESC.desc: Monitored on the OCC board. No action beyond continued observation and evidence accumulation.

ESC.title: Duty manager assessment
ESC.desc: Duty manager reviews exposure and knock-on pathways, then sets a review interval.

ESC.title: VP engagement
ESC.desc: VP Network Control Centre briefed on scale, duration, exposure and time available.
ESC.trigger: EDPS 65–79 at moderate confidence or above

ESC.title: VP decision · response cell
ESC.desc: VP chairs the response cell and approves pre-tactical measures. All decisions remain with the airline.
ESC.trigger: EDPS 80+ at high confidence, or hub threatened

PHASES.title: Detect & verify
steps: Confirm event correlated across two or more tier-1 sources
Resolve flagged contradictions in the evidence trail
Record stated assumptions and information gaps
Set monitoring interval

PHASES.title: Assess exposure
steps: Review the domain implication profile
Walk the knock-on pathway with each desk
Identify hub and wave exposure windows
Log residual uncertainty

PHASES.title: Escalation decision
steps: Compare score and confidence to the threshold table
Brief VP on scale, duration, exposure, time available
Record the decision and its timestamp
Agree the next review point

PHASES.title: Pre-tactical actions
steps: Approve the schedule thinning envelope
Approve the pre-cancellation window
Authorise resource pre-positioning
Hand parameters to the airline disruption solver

PHASES.title: Activate & communicate
steps: Stand up the response cell and briefing cadence
Issue internal and station briefings
Align customer communication timing
Track deviation from the expected profile

PHASES.title: Recover & review
steps: Close out the event and stand down the cell
Reconstruct the intelligence versus action timeline
Test whether thresholds were set correctly
Update playbook content

storm.title: SOP — Winter storm / severe wind
storm.meta: Airline-configured playbook · 4 gates · 12 actions · owner: OCC standards

actions.text: Confirm forecast agreement across national met services and record ensemble spread.
Identify hubs and waves inside the forecast wind field.
Request de-icing and wind-plan capacity statements from affected airports.
Review alternate airports for exposure to the same wind field.
Brief VP NCC if EDPS remains at or above 80 with high confidence.
If the gust forecast exceeds crosswind limits, prepare schedule thinning options for approval.
Confirm pre-cancellation decisions are published to stations and customer channels.
Move to declared disruption cadence with fixed briefing intervals.
Track actual acceptance rates against the forecast reduction and report deviation.
If diversion count exceeds the agreed threshold, open the recovery aircraft review.
Assess overnight positioning and morning wave readiness.
Complete the post-event review including the intelligence-versus-action timeline.

atc.title: SOP — ATC industrial action
atc.meta: Airline-configured playbook · 4 gates · 10 actions · owner: OCC standards

actions.text: Record notice scope, unions involved and the declared window.
Retrieve capacity reduction outcomes from comparable previous notices.
If the third union ballot passes, re-score the event and re-brief.
Map exposed overflight corridors and identify reroute options.
Brief VP NCC on the projected reduction range and cost envelope.
Await the DGAC reduction requirement; if unpublished by T−36h, plan against the historical range.
Submit the pre-cancellation list to the airline disruption solver for construction.
Confirm crew and passenger communication timing.
Monitor actual slot issue rates against the planned reduction.
Close out and record when the reduction requirement became known.

airspace.title: SOP — Airspace restriction
airspace.meta: Airline-configured playbook · 3 gates · 8 actions · owner: Flight ops standards

actions.text: Record boundaries, altitude bands and stated duration.
Cross-check against adjacent state publications for conflicting extents.
Identify affected flows and corridor capacity after displacement.
If reroutes cross states requiring permits, open the permit review.
Review the security risk assessment for alternate routings.
Brief the duty manager on fuel and payload consequences.
Monitor for extension or altitude release amendments.
Re-confirm the restriction remains as published while the duration is open-ended.

runway.title: SOP — Runway closure / works overrun
runway.meta: Airline-configured playbook · 3 gates · 7 actions · owner: Station ops standards

actions.text: Record scope, published acceptance rates and the planned reopening date.
Track contractor milestone progress against plan.
If completion slips, model reduced-capacity days beyond the planned end.
Request a revised completion date in writing from the airport.
Brief the duty manager on peak-hour exposure per affected day.
Review slot compliance and reactionary delay carry-over.
Confirm the full acceptance rate is restored before releasing buffer.

ground.title: SOP — Ground handler industrial action
ground.meta: Airline-configured playbook · 4 gates · 9 actions · owner: Station ops standards

actions.text: Record the bargaining unit, airports covered and ballot close date.
Down-weight unsourced participation estimates in the evidence trail.
If the ballot passes, re-score the event and move to Prepare.
Confirm alternative handling capacity and contractual coverage per station.
Assess minimum service obligations where they apply.
Brief the duty manager on turnaround time assumptions per station.
Agree the baggage acceptance and customer communication position.
Track actual ground times against assumption and report deviation.
Monitor baggage backlog clearance rate.

regulatory.title: SOP — Regulatory change / consultation
regulatory.meta: Airline-configured playbook · 3 gates · 6 actions · owner: Regulatory affairs

actions.text: Record scope, affected airports and the consultation timetable.
Track published submissions for indications of likely direction.
If draft figures are published, model the schedule construction impact.
Submit the airline response and log the expected determination date.
Re-score the event against the final measure.
Feed confirmed limits into the season timetable build.
